# opnsense_dnsmasq_option (Data Source)

Configure DHCP options for dnsmasq.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_dnsmasq_option" "example" {
  id = "<uuid>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the option.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) You may enter a description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `force` (Boolean) Always send the option, also when the client does not ask for it in the parameter request list.
- `interface` (String) This adds a single interface as tag so this DHCP option can match the interface of a DHCP range.
- `option` (Number) DHCPv4 option to offer to the client.
- `option6` (Number) DHCPv6 option to offer to the client.
- `set_tag` (String) Tag to set for requests matching this range which can be used to selectively match DHCP options
- `tag` (Set of String) If the optional tags are given then this option is only sent when all the tags are matched. Can be optionally combined with an interface tag.
- `type` (String) "Set" option to send it to a client in a DHCP offer or "Match" option to dynamically tag clients that send it in the initial DHCP request.
- `value` (String) Value (or values) to send to the client. The special address 0.0.0.0 or [::] is taken to mean "the address of the machine running Dnsmasq". When using "Match", leave empty to match on the option only.
